title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, which share the same underlying model: Fable is available to all users, while Mythos is limited to vetted cyber and biomedical organizations. The update brings better coding, reasoning, and vision, output up to 30% faster than 5.1, and an optional fast mode up to 2.5x faster at a higher price, with pricing of $8 per million input and $40 per million output tokens. Cyber and bio safeguards block about 55% fewer legitimate queries, and Anthropic self-reports that Fermat's Last Theorem was formalized in 30 hours with about 1,000 agents.

title: Introducing Claude for Manufacturing
summary: Claude for Manufacturing is a plugin with 17 skills and connectors to Autodesk Fusion, Infor, Microsoft 365, and Oracle NetSuite, for drafting quotes, quality reports, and supplier requests and for multi-step flows such as job pricing and investigating failed inspections. A separate Infor plugin can act inside Infor, such as releasing POs or rescheduling production, with approval and user permissions. Humans review output before it reaches customers or suppliers, the plugin does not operate equipment, and it is available on Team and Enterprise plans.

title: Your apps can now open in Claude, and Claude can work in them
summary: Partner apps (connectors) can now open inside Claude beside chat or full screen, and Claude can edit open pages, rows, and files directly, with the user approving actions. Users can open tools without a prompt and pin them to the sidebar or the + menu, on web and desktop across all plans, starting with a few directory tools, and admins can restrict tools. Developers can build full apps on the MCP Apps extension, which is in public preview.

title: Operate Claude Managed Agents inside your security perimeter
summary: Self-hosted Claude Managed Agents are in private beta, letting the harness, sandboxes, credentials, and session history run in a customer's cloud or on-prem. Customers can route models through Anthropic, Bedrock, Google Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry, or their own gateway. Credentials stay out of the sandbox, network allowlists apply, and each step is logged via OpenTelemetry, targeting unattended agents that work on internal code and systems.

title: More ways to work with Claude: Sheets, Whiteboards, and Interactive Connectors
summary: Claude adds new artifact types, Sheets, Whiteboards, and Data, plus interactive connectors, so users can build spreadsheets, shared whiteboards, and dashboards over sources such as Snowflake and Salesforce. Partners such as Adobe and Atlassian can embed apps in Claude, and Claude Meetings is coming soon. Customers report Gusto contract turnaround dropping from over a week to hours and Advantage Solutions forecasts falling from 10 hours to under 30 minutes, with admin controls, spend limits, and Claude auto-connect in beta.

title: The Claude Tag guide for startups
summary: This guide to Claude Tag (beta), based on 8 startups, covers @mentioning Claude in Slack, connecting tools, and assigning tasks across five use cases: on-call triage, turning threads into draft PRs, a knowledge base, data analysis, and recurring reports. Reported results include a Campfire mention-to-PR in 21 minutes, NavigateAI merging 134 PRs, and Moritz cutting a daily update from about an hour to 5 minutes. Its advice is to start with one task, narrow access, require human review before merge, and set spend limits, and Claude Tag is available only on Team and Enterprise plans and not with ZDR, CMEK, or HIPAA configurations.
